module: ScriptAI scenario editor: 'Edit ScriptAI Scenario' edit mode (BNGMicrochip toolbar icon) to create, edit and run scripted vehicle trajectories and a camera path. It opens several windows: Script AI Editor (play/pause/loop timeline), Scene Vehicles (vehicles and recording), Scene Trajectories (list), up to three individual trajectory windows, Camera Trajectory and Draw Trajectory. Trajectories are either time-based (nodes x, y, z, t) or speed-based (nodes x, y, z, v). At run time, each trajectory is sent to the vehicle by ai.startFollowing(...) and the camera path is played by core_paths.playPath.
notes: Constants: speed increment 0.2778 m/s (1 km/h), minimum speed 0.1 m/s, maximum 41.67 m/s (150 km/h); standard forward (0,1,0) and up (0,0,1) axes.
At launch, for a time-based trajectory whose first node has t > 0, this t becomes startDelay and is subtracted from all nodes.
If the camera is included (isOnExecute), camera nodes are added at t = 0 and t = tEnd if missing; the FOV is set to 65 and bullettime to 1.
Save/load via editor_fileDialog in JSON: the data is encoded with lpack.encode in the data field (trajectories, camera, vehicles {jBeam, config}, current time, visible windows).
onVehicleSubmitRecording does nothing if the active edit mode is not 'Edit ScriptAI Scenario'; otherwise it creates a trajectory 'recorded_N' (speed-based if path[1].v exists, otherwise time-based).
onDeactivate hides all the tool's windows; onActivate clears the object selection and displays the main window.
The three individual trajectory windows are a maximum fixed by the code (name1 to name3).

onEditorGui.desc: Drawing hook called every editor UI frame: handles mouse and gizmos (selection, drag, free drawing), draws the trajectories and all the tool's windows (main, vehicles, list, trajectories, camera, drawing).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called when the editor world initializes: creates the scriptAIEditMode edit mode (onActivate/onDeactivate, icon, hideObjectIcons) and registers the eight windows; shows again those that were visible before a reload.

onVehicleSubmitRecording.desc: Hook called when a vehicle's recording stops (ai.stopRecording returned to the GE): detaches the vehicle's old trajectory and creates a new trajectory 'recorded_N' from data.path.

data.desc: Recording containing path (nodes with t or v).

onVehicleReplaced.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is replaced: updates the text and jBeam of the trajectories linked to this id.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook (Lua reload): returns {d = lpack.encode{...}} with trajectories, camera, time, selections and button alphas; the windows are noted as not visible.

onDeserialized.desc: Restoration hook after Lua reload: decodes data.d and restores trajectories, camera, time, unique identifiers and window state.
